ueberUns.headline: About us
ueberUns.description: We are a young and dynamic company in Duisburg – in the heart of the Ruhr area. Our services include mediation, management and valuation of real estate. As a professional contact, we are also at your side for all questions relating to rental properties. Through market analyses, our real estate agents are always up to date with the latest economic developments. At DERKO you will find knowledgeable and professional real estate agents who are distinguished by their expertise and local know-how. Our top priority is customer satisfaction and we adapt quickly to the environment and the needs of our customers.
